title: Early-Refill Allowance Schedule for Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Sensor Refills
content:
Payer program schedule note — Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, Larkfield Medical Supply.

Applies to a sensor refill (A4239) on a tier where each refill requires the customer's own confirmation — the CGM Commercial HMO Program, CGM Commercial PPO Program, CGM Medicare Advantage Program, CGM Original Medicare Program and CGM Medicaid Program — that draws on the authorization grant resting on the newest written order of the item.

## The allowance

The payer's early-refill allowance moves the paid-supply end of the latest refill, the day on which the supply the payer paid for on that refill is reckoned to end, earlier by a number of calendar days. It is set by these rules, reading the supply days of the latest refill (the item's refill shipment with the latest ship date):

1. When the latest refill carried at least one standard shipment's supply days (the tier's standard days of supply per refill shipment), the paid-supply end moves earlier by one fifth of those days, rounded down to a whole day.
2. When it carried at least 30 but fewer days than that, the paid-supply end moves earlier by the tier's refill ship lead days.
3. Otherwise — the latest refill carried fewer than 30 days, or the item has no earlier refill — the paid-supply end does not move: the allowance is 0 days.


## Schedule by tier

| Tier | Standard days of supply per refill shipment | Refill ship lead days | Allowance after a 30-day refill | after a 60-day refill | after a 90-day refill |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 30 | 7 | 6 days (rule 1) | 12 days (rule 1) | 18 days (rule 1) |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 90 | 10 | 10 days (rule 2) | 10 days (rule 2) | 18 days (rule 1) |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 90 | 10 | 10 days (rule 2) | 10 days (rule 2) | 18 days (rule 1) |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 90 | 10 | 10 days (rule 2) | 10 days (rule 2) | 18 days (rule 1) |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 30 | 7 | 6 days (rule 1) | 12 days (rule 1) | 18 days (rule 1) |

On the 30-day tiers no refill of 30 days or more falls under rule 2, since every such refill already carries at least one standard shipment's supply days; their refill ship lead days of 7 therefore never become the allowance. The CGM Self-Pay Program (30 standard days, 7 lead days) needs no per-refill confirmation and is outside this note.

## Boundaries on a 90-day tier

- A refill of exactly 90 days meets rule 1: one fifth of 90 is 18 days.
- A refill of 60 days is below 90 and at least 30: rule 2, 10 days.
- A refill of exactly 30 days still meets rule 2: 10 days.
- A refill of fewer than 30 days, or no earlier refill: rule 3, an allowance of 0 days.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

On the CGM Commercial PPO Program, a latest refill of 90 days billed by payer claim shipped on a hypothetical 1 March. Without the allowance its paid supply would be reckoned to end on 30 May, its ship date plus its 90 days; the allowance moves the paid-supply end 18 days earlier, to 12 May.
